description: Type text into element_index, or into the focused element (of app, if given). mechanism auto (default): inserted through accessibility at the caret (AXSelectedText) — IME-safe, clipboard untouched, works in a background app; delivered_verified only when the value reads back as exactly the old value with the text over the selection that was there (unreadable caret: delivered_unverified). replace:true sets the whole value instead (already that text: nothing sent). If the focused element is a text view that takes no text through accessibility (a terminal), auto falls back to physical keystrokes (not IME-safe; app is then a focus guard: refused unless that app is frontmost); a focused button, list or sheet gets none. When the app reports no focused element, auto sends keystrokes only if app names that app (else no_focus, nothing sent). The result names the app it typed into. mechanism physical forces keystrokes (clicking element_index first).
name: mac_type
